title: SB5747 (2023-2024 Regular): Concerning projectile stun guns.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/biennium/2023-24/Htm/Bills/Senate%20Bills/5747.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced version. Only change is the added clause in the 'firearm' definition; RCW 9.41.010 is otherwise reenacted unchanged.

operative_text: Sec. 1 (RCW 9.41.010): (16) "Firearm" means a weapon or device from which a projectile or projectiles may be fired by an explosive such as gunpowder. "Firearm" does not include a flare gun or other pyrotechnic visual distress signaling device, or a powder-actuated tool or other device designed solely to be used for construction purposes, or a projectile stun gun (as defined in RCW 9A.04.110) lawfully possessed by a sworn peace officer.
